classes.docstring:
A knowledge graph for code analysis using NetworkX.

Nodes represent:
- Modules (files)
- Functions
- Classes
- Methods

Edges represent:
- CONTAINS (module contains function/class)
- CALLS (function calls another function)
- IMPORTS (module imports another module)
- INHERITS (class inherits from another class)
- HAS_METHOD (class has method)
